english.note: Use 速度 as the all-purpose noun for a general or measurable rate of motion, including the broad idea of moving quickly.
Use 速度 as the all-purpose noun for general speed or velocity.
This is the all-purpose choice for physical speed or the speed at which something changes or progresses.

examples.english: This car's speed is really high.
examples.traditional: 呢架車嘅速度真係好高。
